title: SuTRA：具有词根感知的结构统一分词方法
summary: SuTRA是一种形态感知的分词算法，保持akshara不可分割性，惩罚跨形态边界的合并，减少形态破碎。在印地语、马拉地语和古吉拉特语上，相比BPE，边界F1提升14.7%，语义可恢复性提升34%，机器翻译chrF2平均提升8.08。
summary_en: SuTRA is a morphology-aware tokenization algorithm that preserves akshara indivisibility and penalizes merges crossing morphological boundaries, reducing morphological shattering. It achieves +14.7% Boundary F1, +34% semantic recoverability (Hindi), and +8.08 chrF2 in MT over BPE.
